title: FPF Evidence Log Record
description: Per-claim and per-gap record for evidence maturity tracking and chain analysis. Each JSONL line is one claim or one gap, discriminated by record_type. External tools reconstruct evidence chains, track maturity transitions over time, and link to decisions and vocabulary.

session_id.description: Session in which this record was written

record_type.description: Discriminator: claim = statement about truth, gap = missing evidence

domain.description: Cynefin domain when this record was written

depth_tier.description: FPF depth tier when this record was written

claim.description: Claim data. Present when record_type is 'claim'.

source.description: Who or what is the source

context.description: Bounded context this claim belongs to

test_method.description: If verified: how it was tested

why_assumed.description: If assumed: why it was taken as given

why_unknown.description: If unknown: why no basis exists

verification_path.description: How this claim could be verified, if known

importance.description: How critical this claim is to the decision

previous_maturity.description: Previous maturity tag, if this record represents a transition

transition_timestamp.description: When the maturity tag changed, if this is a transition record

gap.description: Gap data. Present when record_type is 'gap'.

related_claim_ids.description: Claim record IDs this gap relates to

impact_if_wrong.description: Consequence if the missing evidence proves the claim false

cost_to_close.description: Effort required to fill this gap

decision.description: fill = close the gap, accept = proceed anyway, defer = wait until closed

closed.description: Whether this gap has been closed

closed_timestamp.description: When this gap was closed, if applicable

c11_context.description: Choose-now-vs-probe context for this record's parent decision

decision_log_ids.description: All decision records linked to this evidence

vocabulary_log_ids.description: Vocabulary records related to this evidence
